hook_sub: Straight from the USDA canning guide

slides.t: Let steam flow from the open vent for a full 10 minutes before adding the weight. Trapped air keeps the canner too cool.
Above 1,000 feet you need more pressure. Check the altitude chart in a tested recipe and adjust before you start.
If pressure drops below the target at any point, bring it back up and start the processing time over from zero.
Turn off the heat and let it drop to zero on its own. Wait 10 more minutes, then open the lid away from your face.
Dial gauges drift over time. Have yours checked every year. Weighted gauges don't need testing.
